It's a fine place. It is typically more productive for discussion to happen on the discussion forum before issues are posted on GitHub, though that is not a requirement.

replies.author: Fauxkie
replies.text: otterfoghornrainfall Tell me do y'all think different inboxs, for different SIMs seems like a good feature?

replies.author: de0u
replies.text:
Fauxkie Something that some people have asked for is compartmentalizing SIMs via profiles. So one SIM could be wired to the owner profile (calls and messages) and another SIM could be wired to a secondary user profile.

I mention that not because I think it would be easy, but because I can imagine it might be complicated to have Messaging both support separate "boxes" for different SIMs and to have Messaging in some profiles to be left out of messages in other profiles.

Also, I have a question about multiple "boxes": let's say I have a primary SIM for when I'm home, and I travel somewhere and get a temporary tourist SIM, and I send a message from the tourist SIM to somebody I know from back home. Do users want that message to go into a separate box for the separate SIM?
